svg.aria-label: BCBC 2024 Article 9.10.18.1 Access Provided through a Firewall
svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.10.18.1 Access Provided through a Firewall
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.10 FIRE PROTECTION

g.text: areas on both sides as if one building
160 + 150 = 310 occupants, counted together because access is provided through the firewall.
310 is more than 300, so a fire alarm system is required by Clause 9.10.18.2.(2)(b).
Each side alone, at 160 or 150, would not reach that Clause.

svg.text: Where access is provided through a firewall,
to the floor areas on both sides of the
firewall as if they were in the same building
Drawn: one storey, roof and near walls removed. Red: the firewall, with a doorway through it.
